product.name: Zoom API and Zoom App Marketplace OAuth apps

source.quote: Public and unlisted apps undergo a dedicated review process.

oauthAppCreation.where: The Zoom App Marketplace build flow: create the app, then use its development credentials

source.quote: In the development phase, use the build flow to create your app.

reviewGate.trigger: Public and unlisted apps (usable outside your own Zoom account) must pass the Marketplace review, which includes a security review of requested scopes. Private and beta apps need no review.

source.quote: Public and unlisted apps undergo a dedicated review process.

moreSources.quote: Private and beta apps do not require review.

approvalWait.stated: Review submission response time is within 5 business days. This is the first response, not the end-to-end approval.
approvalWait.derivation: 5 business days is about 7 calendar days

source.quote: The app review submission response time is within 5 business days.

testBeforeApproval.how: Use the development client ID and credentials; share a private app inside your own Zoom account via an authorization URL

source.quote: You can share your private apps and beta apps via distribution of an authorization URL.

blockers.summary: The Marketplace security review checks that the app requests only the minimum OAuth scopes and may ask for unused scopes to be removed

source.quote: the app only requests the minimum necessary OAuth scopes required for its functionality

blockers.summary: Private and beta apps cannot be published, and sharing a beta app outside your account needs Zoom's approval

source.quote: You must get approval from Zoom to share the authorization URL outside your account.

blockers.summary: Submission completeness is checked first: accurate metadata, technical design documentation and security information are required

source.quote: Requirements include accurate metadata, technical design documentation, security information.

blockers.summary: Refresh tokens expire after 90 days, so users must re-authorize if the refresh token lapses

avoidProducts.name: Zoom Meeting SDK
avoidProducts.why: SDK embedding has its own review requirements, separate from OAuth app review
avoidProducts.evidence: The app review page lists Meeting SDK feature review & requirements as a separate section

notes: The 5 business day figure is Zoom's stated response time, not time to approval, so the wait is low confidence.
Zoom scope names are quoted as bare strings because the scope reference is a long table with no per-scope prose.
